summary: Answer strict exact RFI/Submittal Paragraph, Clause and Article-reference questions from typed same-workflow primary evidence before model dispatch.
decision_refs: The active objective requires efficient accurate questions across RFI, Submittal and Email content
The shared answer validator already defines an atomic typed dotted-reference boundary
The existing workflow index and immutable evidence can answer exact reference lists without a second index or provider cost
approval_evidence: The persistent objective authorizes bounded efficiency, accuracy and adaptability improvements across RFI, Submittal and Email question flows.
known_limitations: Only strict English questions naming one exact RFI or Submittal and an explicit reference type use the local shortcut.
Only typed dotted Paragraph, Para, Clause or Article values in exact primary evidence participate; unlabelled and date-shaped values do not.
More than eight distinct references, wrong or multiple workflow scope, quoted history, vision narration and more than 32 primary files or candidate passages fail closed.
The shortcut does not infer hierarchy, applicability, revision, chronology, authority or which source controls.
